description: This Java file defines an Android Activity, ResourcesSample, which demonstrates various ways to load and access resources (such as strings and styled text) within an Android application. It showcases the usage of getString(), getText(), and Resources object methods to retrieve resources and set them into TextViews.

classes.name: ResourcesSample
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating resource loading techniques, including getString(), getText(), and Resources object methods.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and populates TextViews with styled and plain text resources.
